content: Barnabaasanne Sa7oole Kiiteteth

Anxokiyan diza Woosa Keeththan nabetinne astamaareti deettes; heytikka Barnabaasinne Negere geetettiza Simoonara, Qareena dere as Luqiyoosara, Herdoosara issife diccida Minaheranne Sa7oolera wuri issife deettes.
Heyti wuri Godaas goynnishenne xoomishe dishin Xillo Ayanay, «Barnabaasanne Sa7oole ta istta xeygida oosos taas shaakki kessite» gides.
Isttika xoomi woossidi ba kushe istta bolla woththidaappe guye moyzida.
Barnabaasinne Sa7ooli Qophiroose Geetettizason
Barnabaasinne Sa7ooli Xillo Ayana kiitan duge Selawuqiya wodhdhida; heeppeka markaben gelidi Qophiroose bida.
Salmise geetettizaso gakkidi Ayhudata Woosa Keeththatan Xoossa qaala sabbakida; Marqoosa geetettiza Yohannisikka isttara biidi istta maaddides.

Abba giddon diza biitta Qophiroose geetettiza dereyo ha gaxappe he gaxa gakkanaas kanththi kezidi Phaafa geetettizaso gakkishin issi Ayhuda asa shin maronne wordo nabe Baar-Yesusa geetettiza as demmida.
Izikka issi Sarggoosa Phawuloosa geetettiza wozinama dere ayssizayssara issife dees; hessi dere ayssiza addezi Xoossa qaala siyana koyidi Barnabaasanne Sa7oole xeygisides.
Marozi Elimaasi ba sunththaa birsheththa mala dere ayssizayssi ammanontta mala dhuphanaas koyidi isttara eqettides.
Phawuloosa geetettida Sa7ooli Xillo Ayanay izan kumiin maroza tishshi histti xeellidi,
«Nenoo xilloteth ubbaas morkkezoo! Geneynne iitateththi nenan kumidaysso haysso daabulosa nawu! Godaa suure oge geellaseththafe shempikii?

Hekko ha7i Godaa kushey ne bolla dees; ne qooqana; hannife guye arshe poo7o issinokka beyakka» gides. Heerakka shaarumaynne dhumay iza bolla wodhdhides; kushe oykki bana kaaleththanaade koshshi yaanne haa gides.
Dere ayssizayssi ha hanida yo7oza be7idi Godaa gishshas siyida timirtezan malalettidi ammanides.
Phissidiya Geetettiza Deren Barnabaasanne Sa7oole
Phawuloosinne izara dizayti Phaafappe dendidi Phinfiliya geetettizason diza Phergene geetettizaso markaben geli bida; Yohannisi isttafe shaakettidi guye Yerusalaame simmides.
Istti gidikko Phergeneppe dendidi Phissidiya giddon diza Anxokiya bida; Sambata gallas Ayhudata woosa keeth geli uttida.
Muse woga maxaafatinne nabeta maxaafati nababettidaappe guye Ayhudata Woosa Keeththa halaqati, «Nu ishatoo! Inttes hayssa asaa zorana qaalay diikko haasayte» giidi isttako ase yeddida.
Phawuloosikka dendi eqqidi ba kushera malatidi, «Intteno Isra7eele asatoo! Qasseka intteno Xoossas yayyiza Ayzaabetoo! siyite.
Ha Isra7eele dere Xoossay kase nu aawata doorides; istti Gibxe deren dishin istta dhoqqu dhoqqu histtides; ba wolqqama qesera heeppe istta kessides.
Oyddu tammu layth kumeth istta bazzo biittan dandaydes.
Kanaane biittan dizayta laappun kawota dhayssidi istta biittaa ba deretas gade histti laatissides.
Hessi wuri polettiday oyddu xeetanne ichchashu tammu layththata giddona; hessafe guye nabe Sameela wode gakkanaas istta bolla pirdiza daannata immides.
«Hessafe guye derey ba bolla kawo kawoththana mala Sameela woossides; Xoossayka Biniyaame baggafe Qiise naa Sa7oole isttas immides; izikka istta oyddu tammu layth haarides.
Sa7oole shaaridaappe guye Dawite kawoththides; iza gishshas, ‹Ta wozina mala hanizayssanne ta koyidayssa ubbaa ooththiza Isseye naa Dawite ta demmadis› giidi Dawite gishshas Xoossi markkattides.
Xoossika ba caaqo qaalaaththo ha addeza zereththafe as ashshizayssa Yesusa Isra7eeles ehides.
Yesusi yaanaappe kase Yohannisi Isra7eele derey wuri maaroteththan gelidi xammaqettana mala sabbakides.
Yohannisi ba kiitettidayssa polo bolla dishe, ‹Ta inttes oona misatazinaa? Ta kiitettidayssa gidikke; haray attoshin ta izas toho caamma kire birshanaas bessonttayssi taappe guyera yaana› gides.
«Intteno Abrahaame zereththafe yelettida nu ishatoo! Qasseka intte giddonkka Xoossas yayyizayti wuri hayssi atoteththa kiitay kiitettiday nuus ubbatassa!
Yerusalaame asatinne istta halaqati Yesusa eribeettenna; gido attiin istti iza bolla pirdida; hessankka sambatan sambatan nababettiza kase nabeta qaalay iza bolla polettides.
Iza hayqos gaththiza issi gaasokka istti demmontta aggikokka Philaxoosi iza bolla hayqo pirda pirdana mala woossida.
Iza gishshas xaafettidayssa istti ubbaa polidaappe guye iza kaqettida miththaa bollafe gaden woththidi duufon moogida.
Gido attiin Xoossi iza hayqoppe denththides.
Galilappe Yerusalaame gakkanaas banara dizaytas daro wode beettides; heytikka ha7i iza gishshas deretas markkatta.
«Nunikka kase Xoossi nu Aawatas caaqqida Mishiraachcho qaalaa inttes sabbakoos.
Yesusa kiittidi isttas caaqqida qaalaa nuus istta naytas polides; hessika mazamure maxaafan nam7anththo shempon, ‹Ne ta naaza; ta nena hach yeladis› geetetti xaafettides.
Qasseka izi wooqqonttayssanne Xoossi iza hayqoppe denththidayssa shaakki erana mala,
«Dawiti ba woden Xoossa shene mala ooththidaappe guye hayqqides; kase ba aawatara moogettiin iza ashoy wooqqides.
Xoossi iza hayqoppe denththidayssi izi gidikko wooqqibeenna.
Hessa gishshas ta ishatoo! Nagaras maaroteththi beettizay Yesusa baggara gididayssi inttes sabbakettidayssa erite.
Iza ammanizaadey wuri kase Muse wogaa baggara demmontta xilloteth demmana.
Hessa gishshas kase nabeti,
Phawuloosinne Barnabaasi Ayhudata Woosa Keeththafe kezishin asay istta hessa istti yootida qaalaa kaalliza Sambata gallas zaari yootana mala woossides.

Shiiqoy laalettidaappe guye daro Ayhudatinne Ayhudata ammanon gelidi Xoos goynniza asati Phawuloosanne Barnabaasa kaallida. Phawuloosanttika istta qofsishe istti Xoossa kiyateththan minni daana mala zorida.
Kaalliza Sambata gallas katama asappe guuththati xalala attiin dariza baggay wuri Godaa qaalaa siyana shiiqides.
Ayhudatikka daro dere be7idi qanaateteththan kumida; Phawuloosa haasaya eqettishe iza cayida.

Phawuloosinne Barnabaasi babbontta xalateththan, «Xoossa qaalay koyro inttes yootettanaas bessees; gido attiin intte qaalaa leqqideta. Inttes mernaa de7oy bessonttayssa intterkka intte bolla pirdida gishshas ha7i nuni gede Ayzaabetakko baana koyoos; qasseka Goday nuna, ‹Asas atoteththa qaala biitta gaxa gaththana mala ta nena Ayzaabetas poo7o histta kiittadis› gi azazides» gida.
Ayzaabeti hessa siyidi daro ufayettida; Godaa qaalaska bonchcho immida; mernaa de7os giigettida derey wuri ammanides.
Godaa qaalay heeran diza dere ubbaso gakkides.

Ayhudati qasse Ayana hanon kaseppe minnizaytanne duussan bonchchettida maccassata hessaththoka kataman diza gita asata denththeththidi Phawuloosa bollanne Barnabaasa bolla goodeteth denththidi ba dereppe kessi gooddida.
Phawuloosinne Barnabaasi asay istta ixxidayssa bessanaas ba toho bolla diza gudulla pittidi Iqoniyoone geetettizaso bida.
Ammanizayti ufayssaninne Xillo Ayanan kumida.

footnotes.text: Negerey Laatine qaala gidishin birsheththay kareth guussa.
Dandaydes: Dandaydes issi issi Geeshsha Maxaafati istta lo7eththi oykkides geettes.
